macros.name: texttwemoji
macros.doc: Uses the \twemoji command so that it adapts to the fontsize.

macros.name: twemoji
macros.doc: Includes the given twemoji as an image in place.

macros.name: twemojiDefaultHeight
macros.doc: Per default \includegraphics is given the parameter height=\twemojiDefaultHeight, where \twemojiDefaultHeight is set to \fontcharht\font‘X (i.e. the height of the letter X).
